annotations.title: Update photo or video alt text

description: Update metadata on one uploaded picture or video: set or clear accessible alt text (up to 1000 characters), rename the file (1 to 120 characters), or set organization tags (up to 10 tags, 40 characters each). Refused with 410 if the file was already purged.

alt.description: Accessible description of what the picture shows, up to 1000 characters. Send empty text to clear it.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: A media id from media_upload or media_list.

name.description: Display filename for this asset in the media library, 1 to 120 characters.

tags.description: Organization tags for filtering in the media library, up to 10 tags (40 characters each). Send an empty array to clear tags.

items.description: Short organization tag, up to 40 characters.

name: media_update
title: Update photo or video alt text
